quest.title: Serpent's Heart Inquiry
quest.description: Clear the trials according to the path prescribed by the spirit named Aberaku and obtain the offerings...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Are you fully girded up, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: My name is...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Aberaku, Helios-Forger!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, what's the Helios?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it something very impressive?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Verily! T'was I who organized the building of the Helios with the might of an entire nation behind me, that we might resist the Dragonheirs of the Depths.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: This unsurpassed deed could have been done by no other in Byakuyakoku — none save I!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Guess that is pretty impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But why would such a great person be sealed in here?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: I... I was betrayed...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: When the sky kingdom crashed into the bottomless depths, the people were scourged by dragons, and thus did I — yes, 'twas I — begin building the Helios to save us all from our fate.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: But... those ravening rogues! The moment their lives were no longer in danger, they began to deceive and lie. They even advocated placing mere infants on the throne. Laughable!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Even I became the target of their schemes, and was left in jail to rot!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: A pox! A pox upon them all!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: ...Right. You.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: My sacred robes were once placed here, but they have all but rotted away in the passing of years, and can no longer be relied upon.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: But if you can pass the test, then I shall hand the offerings, into which I have nested my thoughts, unto you.

response.speaker: Aberaku
response.text: This matter is perilous. Tell me once you are ready, O Traveler, and we shall begin.

choices.text: Paimon, I think he's talking to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nah, he's clearly looking at you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (With a very heated look in his eyes, too.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Then I wish you... every success in your battle ahead.

talks.objective: Obtain the offerings from the spirit

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: I—Incredible! You may just be able to do this...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Please then, I beg you, carry these offerings... the offerings... you must...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: You must take them away to...

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: To...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh brother, his words are getting less and less clear!

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Take them to the place of enshrining... enjoin the parts of my soul, in order to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Mr. Spirit?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: In order to... In order to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In order to do what again?

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: In order to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this guy isn't making himself clear at all! But it seems we're supposed to take these offerings somewhere — Paimon got that much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These offerings have been here for so long. Who knows if there's anything edible here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best not to eat them all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H—Hey! Paimon doesn't just eat anything, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, let's take the offerings with us anyway, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need a while more to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Aberaku
dialogues.text: Then I shall await your tidings.
